headline: Record Fuel Prices Drive 10.2% Surge in European Car Sales Led by EVs
summary: September automobile registrations across Europe rose 10.2 percent year-on-year, according to ACEA data, driven by rising electric and hybrid adoption as record fuel prices suppress conventional vehicle sales.
why: The European Automobile Manufacturers’ Association (ACEA) tracks monthly vehicle registrations across the continent, offering a leading indicator of consumer discretionary spending and the automotive sector's electrification pace.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Total sales volume expanded 10.2% in September supported by resilient EV and hybrid demand.
